comparison.objective: Align pipe flanges and insert locating pins; candidate installs a load-bearing lifting pin, moves a workpiece, seats it, and removes the pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Flange pose alignment and passive locating-pin insertion versus spring-button actuation, radial ball-lock engagement, shackle load control, support verification, and unlocked extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Aligned flange holes with two or four locating pins in final pose versus pull-tested retention, elevated supported load, three-pad contact, complete pin recovery, clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: This is geometrically similar at insertion, but PR-125 lacks mechanical locking, lifting through the pin, load transfer, and pin recovery; its earlier variants omit release and damage-history criteria, which does not make the objectives duplicative.
